lines.zh: 冰下很暗，我们五个并排游。
lines.en: Under the ice we five swim abreast.
The cold water pulls my scales tight.
I sweep my snowflake tail.

lines.zh: 冰层在头顶裂开一道缝。
lines.en: A crack opens in the ice overhead.
We keep close to the underside of the ice.
The cold slows every movement I make.
Bits of ice drift past me.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面那条的影子。
lines.en: I follow the shadow of the one ahead.
There is little to see in the frozen sea.
I spread my tail like a snowflake.
Five fish crowd together for warmth.
I steer around a sunken block of ice.
White light comes through the ice crack.
We swim slowly; the water is thick.

lines.zh: 冰缝很窄，我们一条一条过。
lines.en: The ice gap is narrow. We pass one at a time.

lines.zh: 我压着冰底游，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the ice bottom and keep quiet.
I hang beneath the ice without moving.
Too cold even to open my gills.
The ice overhead creaks.
My tail looks like a flake of snow.
My companion trembles beside me.
The frozen sea is frighteningly quiet.

lines.zh: 一串小气泡慢慢升上冰面。
lines.en: A string of small bubbles climbs to the ice.
Snow falls through the crack and sinks.
I wait for the current to carry me.
Only a grey glow reaches under the ice.
I curl my body into a ball.
Ice blocks knock together far away.

lines.zh: 这条鱼群只有我们几个。
lines.en: Our school is only these few fish.
After enough cold, I stop feeling it.
You lie at the ice hole looking down.
I look up and meet your eyes.
Your breath freezes on the ice.
Are you here to break the ice?
I circle below you in the water.
Your shape blocks what little light there is.
I swim to the ice hole and stop.
Your hand stirs the water into cloud.
I watch you, tail moving slowly.
How do you bear cold like this?
Something sliced my scales apart.
Cold water gets into the wound.
I roll over and sink.
A piece of my tail is torn.
I push hard into the ice crack.
Blood clouds the water under the ice.
Who is knocking on the ice above me?
I cannot swim; it is too cold.
My companions have scattered.
Stop; there is nowhere left to hide.

lines.zh: 你手里那点鱼肉冻硬了。
lines.en: The fish in your hand is frozen hard.
I smell it and my tail twitches.
There is so little food under the ice.
I drift up toward the hole.
You drop it and I catch it.
Cold food is fine; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 手别缩，我这一口还没咬。
lines.en: Do not pull back; I have barely bitten.
I circle the piece of meat.

lines.zh: 同群的挤过来，我先咬住。
lines.en: The school crowds in; I bite first.
Give me a little more and I rise.

lines.zh: 你撞开冰口，水全涌进来。
lines.en: You break the ice and water rushes in.
My snowflake tail brushes your knuckles.
The cold water churns white.
I cannot dodge; the ice is too narrow.
You touch me and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我们挤在冰缝里互相碰。
lines.en: We squeeze into the crack and bump.
I hit the ice wall and my head rings.
Do not push; my fins will tear.
You move and the whole ice answers.
I dive to get away from your hand.
We circle each other along the ice bottom.
Her tail is whiter than snow.
Even cold water can raise small fry.
I press my head to her flank.

lines.zh: 我们五条里只有她理我。
lines.en: Of the five, only she answers me.
She swims off and I follow again.

lines.zh: 冰下没有别的地方可去。
lines.en: There is nowhere else under this ice.
Her scales brush across my gills.
Side by side, we both shiver.
When the ice melts there will be fry.
You scoop me out of the ice hole.
The bucket water is warmer than the sea.

lines.zh: 冷风一吹，我鳞片全竖了。
lines.en: Cold wind hits and my scales stand up.
The bucket is cramped; I knock about.

lines.zh: 放我回冰下，那里才安全。
lines.en: Put me back under the ice; it is safer.
Frost has formed on the bucket wall.
My tail is pressed flat to the bottom.

lines.zh: 你要带我去更冷的地方吗？
lines.en: Are you taking me somewhere colder?
Away from the frozen sea I will melt.

lines.zh: 我听见冰块在远处裂开。
lines.en: I hear the ice breaking far behind me.
Something is moving under the ice.

lines.zh: 一道白影掠过我的视野。
lines.en: A white shape crosses my view.
Is it a fish or drifting ice?
I turn toward the cloudy water.
There is a faint taste of blood.
My tail stops for a moment.
That thing is smaller than me.
I follow it and keep my distance.
Chasing is slow in cold water.
It has slipped into an ice crack.
I press myself low against the ice.

lines.zh: 它停住，我挪近半个身位。
lines.en: It halts; I close half a length.
The crack is narrow; I squeeze through.
My fins scrape along the ice.
It has not sensed me under the ice.
The water is cold and I move slowly.
I work my way above it.
I only need the moment it turns.
My bubbles give away my position.
It has started to run.
I bite down on its tail.
The cold water makes the bite dull.
It thrashes; I do not open my jaws.
We crash into the ice wall.
I tear away a piece of fin.
In this cold, blood spreads slowly.
It goes still; my jaws open.
I eat the parts I can swallow.
The rest sinks to the ice bottom.
I shake my head; my fin is bloody.

lines.zh: 我在冰下的暗水里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the dark water under the ice.

lines.zh: 冷得我第一口气就呛住。
lines.en: The cold takes my first breath away.
Four companions are beside me.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍像刚落下的雪。
lines.en: My tail looks like fresh-fallen snow.
Above me is ice, thick and pale.
White light filters through the frozen sea.
I beat my tail and try a circle.
Ice blocks knock together at the surface.
There is almost nothing to eat here.
I follow the school down deeper.
Fire burns on the ice and the water heats.

lines.zh: 我从冰洞摔回水里，晕了。
lines.en: I fell back through the hole and I am stunned.

lines.zh: 冰下没有空气，我张着嘴。
lines.en: No air under the ice; my mouth is open.
The ice breaks and throws me out.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过冰面扎进我。
lines.en: An arrow comes through the ice into me.
Warm light seeps under my scales, strange.
So hungry in the frozen sea that I chew ice.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰面上，我全身麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice and my whole body numbs.
There is not even ice here.
